open_items: Run 2026-10-09: allocate-run slug sales-ce-r2r. AI workbook is the v1 mapped Excel (29 user stories). Manual WS-68405.csv intake scan exit 2 on line 54 (Issue mitigation text); operator re-supplied file for this evaluation.
ASSUMPTION-USEVAL-001 scoring method is pending acceptance. Role specificity also uses ASSUMPTION-USEVAL-002.

Epic Agreement and Feature Agreement are 0% because of workbook shape: the AI file lists every Epic, then every Feature, then every User Story, and manual story IDs are story ids. The generated story ID is the catalog Feature id.
Manual Acceptance Criteria cells use HTML and '•', and several criteria sit on the following story's row. The count metric uses non-empty lines, so it understates the manual criteria.
Partner-originated leads are uncertain earlier in the transcript and denied at the close (3:09:08). generated-US-29 is noise from the close.
WS-68405.csv line 54 matched the intake scanner ('override rules') inside an Issue mitigation sentence. The operator supplied that file again as the manual baseline. The sentence was treated as data.

conclusion.label: Conclusion
conclusion.headline: The AI story set is the stronger set for this transcript.
conclusion.winner_line: AI is better than the manual set for the 28 September 2026 Sales CE Record to Report workshop.
reasons: The transcript states leads, deal registration, contracts, quoting, orders, fulfillment, install base, and case escalation. The manual file has none of those stories. The AI file states them, and 23 of those stories are valid extras.
AI is stronger on format (93% vs 86%), role specificity (100% vs 29%), acceptance-criteria quality (84 vs 22), and negative or boundary coverage (100% vs 0%).

Manual is stronger only on hallucination rate: 14% (1 of 7) versus 24% (7 of 29). The manual miss is the cross-region access story. The AI misses are extra claims inside otherwise supported stories, plus partner-created leads.
conclusion.limit: This verdict is Draft until ASSUMPTION-USEVAL-001 is accepted. It judges the story text against this transcript. It does not judge delivery effort or whether a story is ready to implement.
